question: Eight metallic spheres of radius 1 cm are melted to form one sphere. The radius of the resulting sphere is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let, r = Radius of a small sphere

R = Radius of the big sphere

We know that the volume of a sphere = (4/3)π(radius)3

So, R³ = r³ × 8 [∵ (4/3)π will be negligible]

R3 = 8 [∵ r = 1 cm]

R = 2 cm

∴ The radius of the resulting sphere is 2 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The radius of the small sphere = 1 cm

**Formula used:**

The volume of a sphere = (4/3)πr³

Where, r = Radius of the sphere

**Calculation:**

The volume of each small sphere = (4/3)π(1)³ = (4/3)π

The total volume of 8 small spheres = 8 × (4/3)π

Let, the radius of the big sphere = R

So, (4/3)πR³ = 8 × (4/3)π

⇒ R3 = 8

⇒ R3 = 23

⇒ R = 2

**∴ The radius of the resulting sphere is 2 cm**
